data_fields.name: dispel_resist_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: none: dispel is an alias of silence and always removes removable modifiers

best_idea: Compute every stat as base, then the last rebasing modifier, then normal modifiers in order with a fixed one as a hard stop, then auras, then clamp to zero; silence removes only the modifiers flagged removable.
decision_why: One stat-modifier function for gear, specials and status effects on the server; take the layered order and the removable flag, fix the donor's aura skip, and leave out the CoffeeScript, art and resources.
acceptance: Server test: base attack 3, rebase to 2, +1 normal buff and +1 aura reads 4; a fixed normal debuff stops later normal buffs; a -5 debuff on 3 reads 0; silence removes the buff and keeps the base.
